decisions.statement: The track playing now is named before the tracks queued behind it.
A queue holding nothing is said rather than left out of the answer.
Nothing playing is said rather than leaving the first line off.
A call saying `--json` is answered one line of JSON, and one saying nothing words.
The reading is handed in, so no test of it reaches Spotify.
The queue is read from the account rather than from a device.
Nothing here changes what is playing.

definition: the command naming the track Spotify plays now and the tracks queued behind it
